summary_markdown:
Multiple industry players are joining the AllUnite rollout in Brazil. Goldbach (New OOH) and DMI (German OOH association) approved a minor pilot in a shopping center in Germany.

The rollout is expanding to include Electromidia, noted as the second-largest OOH player in Brazil, and an additional OOH player specializing in screens within elevators (Helloo media), which reportedly has 25,000 screens. The expansion includes roadside advertising for Rio and São Paulo.

The goal is to go live with these rollouts before the end of the year.
decisions: Minor pilot approved by Goldbach (New OOH) and DMI in German shopping center.
